events.name: Cleveland Cavaliers at Oklahoma City Thunder

rotowire.headline: Mitchell totaled 17 points (6-17 FG, 4-9 3Pt, 1-4 FT), five rebounds and 11 assists in 36 minutes during Monday's 117-112 loss to the Thunder.
rotowire.story: Mitchell found the majority of his success from beyond the arc, which was a welcome sight after watching him go 3-for-13 from deep over his previous two matchups. He also made an impact as a facilitator, setting a new season high in assists on the way to his first double-double of the season. Despite a strong final line from the star guard, it was Shai Gilgeous-Alexander who played spoiler with a 43-point night to lead Oklahoma City to victory.
rotowire.description: Mitchell totaled 17 points (6-17 FG, 4-9 3Pt, 1-4 FT), five rebounds and 11 assists in 36 minutes during Monday's 117-112 loss to the Thunder.

fantasy.projection: Mitchell has consistently been one of the most productive guards in fantasy, and last season was no exception. The Cavaliers made a big in-season trade, sending out Darius Garland and bringing back James Harden, but Mitchell's numbers remained largely consistent in 22 games next to Harden. Harden is a higher usage point guard than Garland but is also a better distributor which should ultimately lead to better looks for Mitchell. Mitchell's shot volume upside may be slightly capped but his efficiency improvement could be even more impactful.
